total_fee_share.meaning: totalFeeShare value at the time _decreaseFeeShares is executed

token_unlocked.meaning: whether the token is unlocked (pair created by launchpad); false means still in bonding curve with no pair created
token_unlocked.checkpoint: before the sole buyer's sell attempt

sole_buyer_sell_completed.meaning: whether the sole buyer's sell of his token to the launchpad completes successfully
sole_buyer_sell_completed.checkpoint: after the sole buyer's sell attempt

assumptions: The sole buyer is the first buyer or last seller while the token is still bonding in the curve.
The sell attempt is the valid operation scenario in which the buyer transfers his token back to the launchpad.

unresolved.description: Report does not specify the exact revert/failure mechanism when the pair is not created; only that the sell cannot complete because endRewardsAccrual is called on a non-existent pair.
Report does not state who triggers _decreaseFeeShares or whether the caller is authorized.

limitations: Impact is formalized as a potential (not inevitable) failure of the sole buyer's sell; the plan encodes the report-supported conditional scenario only.
The end-rewards cascade and root-cause gating are not encoded as P; they are the mechanism behind the failure, not before-conditions.
Other impacts (e.g. cannot_end_rewards_when_it_should) are handled in separate claim-generation passes and are not covered here.
